# meca-llave-agua (ORM, docs/MECANISMOS_ADULTO.md, family F5, Templo del Agua), A: both ADULT at the entrance; a small-key door opened for real (the water level of the room as the save has it), then room 02's key record.
# Run with --transport ws; switches below (#! switches). Needs daurosk branch orm/meca-adulto (the `key` test
# command) on orm/test8 (the `warp ... adult|child`, LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS). Generated by
# tools/harness/meca_adulto.py: change the table there, not this file. Positions from the Banc, not walked yet:
# a 'test place ...: failed' or a 'goto timed out' is the scenario's gap, not the code's.
# Mutant: the same run without LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS turns the 'never' lines of the adult list red.
#! noload
#! start coop: test warp done
#! saves 15-agua
#! switches LICHII_COOP_PUPPET=1,LICHII_COOP_DEBUG_FLAGS=1,LICHII_COOP_DUNGEON_LISTS=shared_dungeon_adult.txt,LICHII_COOP_CHEATS=1
#! timeout 225
#! expect B coop: puppet: P\d: create CoopPuppet_Adult
#! expect A coop: test give DungeonInfo\.WaterTemple\.SmallKeyNum: queued within prep..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: int 0x877bdcee \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within prep..end
#! never A coop: flags debug: int 0x877bdcee \(entry \d+\) 0 -> -1
#! never B coop: flags debug: int 0x877bdcee \(entry \d+\) 0 -> -1
#! expect A coop: world: a836443f9ff95827 Obj_DoorChainLock_A_01 broken here \(.*\): sent within abre..end
#! expect A coop: flags debug: int 0x877bdcee \(entry \d+\) 1 -> 0 within abre..end
#! expect B coop: world: a836443f9ff95827 Obj_DoorChainLock_A_01 (broken by another player|was broken before we saw it) within abre..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: int 0x877bdcee \(entry \d+\) 1 -> 0 within abre..end
#! never B coop: world: a836443f9ff95827 Obj_DoorChainLock_A_01 broken here
#! expect A coop: test flag WaterTemple_Room02_GetSmallKey \(0xc56265f6\) = 1: queued within llave..end
#! expect B coop: flags debug: bool 0xc56265f6 \(entry \d+\) 0 -> 1 within llave..end
mark start
warp WaterTemple WaterTemple_FromLakeHylia adult
wait 1200               # the title screen
mark title
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 180
press A
wait 300
press A                 # loads the save, then the warp
wait 2400               # the save loads, then the warp lands (about 30 s)
mark after
wait 600                # the other game lands too: puppets made
mark prep
give DungeonInfo.WaterTemple.SmallKeyNum
wait 300
mark abre
place -10.95 101.36 -4.50   # 1.4 m in front of the lock a836443f9ff95827
wait 120
toward -8.55 -4.50 30   # face the door
press A
wait 360
mark llave
flag WaterTemple_Room02_GetSmallKey 1
wait 300
wait 300
mark end
